notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Bounding Krasis.
Repeat.
